about.name: Coach Christopher Smalls
about.title: OL/DL
about.bio:
Coach Christopher Smalls brings years of experience running the Option system in New Mexico. With a sharp offensive mind and a track record of developing athletes who perform at the next level, Coach Smalls is known for making practice reps count. Works with athletes at the College, Varsity, Youth level.

From route running to pre-snap reads to protection schemes — Coach Smalls delivers the kind of coaching that shows up in the box score.

hero.headline: New Mexico Football Coach
hero.subline: Personalized offensive football coaching that turns potential into performance.

services.title: Option System Coaching
services.description: Installation and development of the Option offense — from core concepts to advanced adjustments that put defenses in conflict.

services.title: Skill Position Development
services.description: Individual coaching for QBs, WRs, RBs, and TEs focused on technique, route running, footwork, and pre-snap reads.

services.title: Offensive Playbook & Film Study
services.description: Playbook design tailored to your personnel, plus film sessions that sharpen in-game decision making for players and staff.
